visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a hand pouring clear syrup from a small white pitcher onto a large, vibrant blue mound of shaved ice. The ice is topped with a swirl of beige cream adorned with tiny gold pearls. The background is a dimly lit, warm-toned indoor restaurant setting with wooden chairs visible. (2) The scene cuts to the interior of a clean industrial freezer containing multiple stainless steel cylindrical canisters arranged on metal shelves. The lighting is bright and even. Yellow and white text captions appear at the bottom center of the frame to provide context about the homemade ice. (3) Various close-up sequences depict toppings like dark, glossy tapioca pearls and crispy cereal flakes being poured or placed onto different colored ice bases, including light blue and pink. The hands are visible performing these actions, and the focus is sharp on the varied textures of the food items. (4) A spoon scoops into a bowl of shaved ice that is transitioning from deep blue to purple as liquid is poured over it. The background remains the indoor dining area. The lighting highlights the crystalline texture of the ice and the smooth, glossy surface of the added white pearls. (5) A montage showcases several colorful ice desserts, including a multi-colored rainbow shaved ice being drizzled with green syrup and a dark brown tea-flavored ice sprinkled with powder. Each dish is meticulously presented on a wooden tray with side dishes like tea and extra toppings. (6) A man wearing a black cap and glasses is shown briefly in a medium shot, preparing or serving one of the bowls in a clean kitchen area. The video ends with shots of the shop's interior and a bright exterior view of the storefront under daylight, featuring a large banner and a parked scooter.
